description: Read a set of image ads by the id make_image_ads answered: status queued, in_progress, ready or failed. While it is queued or in_progress, call it again about once a minute; ready and failed are final. Ready answers each image ad's headline, second line and button, in headline, subhead and cta, and its download_url; failed answers why and whether its credits were refunded. Each image ad's download_url is made new in every answer and works for the next hour: its download_expires_in_seconds is the seconds it has left as that answer is made. For a later download, call get_image_ads again for a new link. Free.
name: get_image_ads
title: Image ads
